source_text: Filii Ioseph accipiunt sortem — Ephraim et Manasse. Fertilitas gratiae; tamen Chananaeus tributarius remanet.
pass_a_gloss: Sons of-Joseph receive lot — Ephraim and Manasseh. Fertility of-grace; yet Canaanite tributary remains.
pass_b_english: [[Joseph’s sons receive their lot — Ephraim and Manasseh >> Bible:Joshua 16–17]]. Grace is fertile; yet the Canaanite remains as tributary.
